title: The Padel Addict's Guide to Talking About Anything Else

answers.idea: A mock self-help manual for a padel convert who has made the sport his whole personality, teaching him to talk about anything else, at home and at work. The humour is off court: what his padel obsession does to everyone in his life.
answers.title: The Padel Addict's Guide to Talking About Anything Else
answers.buyer: A wife or girlfriend, colleague, friend or sibling of a padel addict, buying it as a birthday, Christmas or Father's Day gift or a Secret Santa.
answers.recipient: A padel-obsessed professional in his late twenties or early thirties who took up the sport recently and now talks about nothing else.
answers.recognition_trigger: Steering every conversation back to padel and saying it is 'the fastest-growing sport in the world'; the padel WhatsApp group pinging at 6am; planning family weekends around court bookings; trying to recruit his dad, his boss and the neighbours; wearing padel kit to a toddler's birthday party; the racket bag in the car boot next to the car seats; 'quick padel stat' in work stand-ups and pushing padel as the team social; a 'padel holiday' to Spain sold as a family trip; calling tennis 'basically padel without the walls'.
answers.main_character_details: Josh, 31, a management consultant, married to Lauren, two children under five (Mia, 4, and Alfie, 1). Fixed look: short beard, a smartwatch he never takes off, and a padel brand cap or quarter-zip whether he is at the office or a toddler's birthday party.
